title: THE FORGE STANDS IN EVERY RAID
why: His question of 2026-10-14: he had not seen the Forge that upgrades weapons and asked if it is on the map. The upgrade rules shipped earlier (MK II, MK III, the four elements, kept on extraction), but the station you walk up to did not. Now every raid has THE FORGE: a furnace block with a glowing mouth, an anvil, embers rising and a warm glow on the ground, a dashed reach ring and its name over it, standing in the aisle between the packing floor and CHILL ROW (moved to the nearest clear, reachable ground if something stands there, never on a crate or inside a wall). It is marked with a gold anvil on the minimap and on the sector map. Walking up to upgrade a gun comes in the next builds. Placing it draws nothing from the seeded stream, so every raid is the same as before.
now: THE FORGE now stands in every raid and is marked on the minimap and the map. Upgrading guns there comes next.
